findings.issue: The mutation runner was VACUOUS: it ran with cwd set to the case directory but passed a repository-relative source path, so every compile failed 'Cannot open file' and the reported 17/17 failures proved nothing.
findings.resolution: Isolated temporary workspaces with absolute paths; compile-fail is now distinguished from run-fail and rejected for runtime mutants. The reviewer confirmed non-vacuity by breaking a parent in a scratch copy and seeing it detected.

findings.issue: An interface mutant imported a nonexistent name, violating C8101, so it failed by becoming non-conforming.
findings.resolution: Replaced by importing an alternate host shape constant that exists, compiles, and changes the checked result.

findings.issue: The C8100 negatives had contains_any but no excludes_any, so an ICE or unimplemented message could count as a diagnosis.
findings.resolution: excludes_any added; its effectiveness was confirmed by a scratch probe.

lesson: A mutation matrix that reports every mutant 'killed' is not evidence until the runner has been shown to detect a deliberately broken parent. 17/17 here meant 17 missing files.

lfortran_defects_recorded.observation: IMPORT in an external subprogram is accepted; C8100 requires a diagnosis
